registryEvidence.custodian: Anxi County Natural Resources Bureau (安溪县自然资源局), including its county-level unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral survey, cadastral mapping, and registration-data management functions.
registryEvidence.scope: The official county procedure page and bureau responsibilities evidence a local registry/procedure custodian. They do not establish an open parcel geometry service or citywide downloadable cadastral layer.

parcelDiscovery.source: Official Anxi County Government and Natural Resources Bureau pages were reviewed; no public anonymous parcel geometry service was qualified.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official county government homepage reviewed. It links government information, local services, and the Fujian/Quanzhou government-service portals, but no parcel-vector endpoint was present in the accessible page content.

Official Natural Resources Bureau page identifies local responsibility for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral survey/mapping, registration data, and spatial information resources. No public map/API URL or parcel schema was exposed.
Official Anxi real-estate registration procedure page returned registration-flow materials. It is procedural evidence, not a public parcel geometry service; no feature query was possible.

Official first-registration notice confirms the Anxi Natural Resources Bureau as registration institution and exposes cadastral-unit identifiers in a notice. Those identifiers were not requested, copied, or retained as parcel samples because the notice contains personal/address-linked land-record data.

The county homepage links the Quanzhou government-service portal as a general service route; no anonymous parcel map/API response or current viewer configuration was evidenced in this attempt. No login or credential route was pursued.
A bounded TLS-verified curl attempt timed out during DNS resolution in the execution environment; this is an environment failure, not evidence of source absence. No TLS verification was disabled.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. No exact-point parcel query was issued because no public parcel layer or API was exposed. A map extent miss, timeout, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: The local registry custodian and procedures are first-party evidenced, but anonymous machine-readable parcel geometry access remains unresolved.
